notes: Added missing schema/contract and response normalization stories for facade completeness.

stories.title: Define Facade Input/Output Contracts
stories.description: Establish explicit request/response schemas for evaluate_care_facade methods, aligning with existing Pydantic tool models for clinical trials and ensuring consistent provider detail response structure.

stories.title: Normalize Aggregated Facade Responses
stories.description: Implement response normalization layer within evaluate_care_facade to standardize outputs from clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service into a unified, chat-consumable format.

stories.title: Implement Error Handling and Fallback Logic
stories.description: Add structured error handling in the facade to gracefully manage partial failures (e.g., trials API failure but provider lookup succeeds), returning safe, user-appropriate responses.

stories.title: Add Facade-Level Debug Logging Integration
stories.description: Integrate debug_logger into evaluate_care_facade to capture orchestration inputs, outputs, and error states for traceability and QA validation.
